meta.title: BC EMALB Examined Protocols
meta.sourcePages: 18-57 (deductions from Grading Criteria p.34 and Appendix A p.39)

indicationsEn: Patient with absent or failing respirations (decreased rate and limited tidal volume) who still has a pulse
Decreased level of consciousness with a depressed respiratory drive (e.g., suspected opioid overdose, drowning, asphyxia)
indicationsZh: 呼吸消失或呼吸衰竭（呼吸频率下降且潮气量受限）但仍有脉搏的患者
意识下降伴呼吸驱动受抑制（例如疑似阿片类过量、溺水、窒息）
stepsEn: 1. Complete a primary survey; manage the airway with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
2. Observe suction time limits: 10-15 seconds adult, 10 seconds paediatric, 5 seconds infant
3. Attempt ventilation; if no air entry or air blows back, reposition the head and reattempt (consider FBAO if the airway remains obstructed)
4. Support ventilations with BVM (IPPV); consider two-person BVM technique
5. Administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
6. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs including blood glucose; if BGL <= 4 mmol/L, correct the glucose level
7. If opioid overdose is suspected (miosis, hypotension, hypothermia, tachycardia), administer Naloxone
8. Monitor closely for deterioration to cardiac arrest: assess breathing and pulse simultaneously in no more than 10 seconds (up to 30-45 seconds if severely hypothermic) and begin CPR if pulseless
9. Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route
stepsZh: 1. 完成 primary survey；通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器（adjunct）按需管理气道
2. 遵守吸引时限：成人 10-15 秒、儿童 10 秒、婴儿 5 秒
3. 尝试通气；如无气体进入或气体反吹，重新摆放头位再试一次（仍梗阻时考虑 FBAO）
4. 用 BVM 支持通气（IPPV）；考虑双人 BVM 技术
5. 给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
6. 采集病史和基线生命体征（含血糖）；血糖 ≤ 4 mmol/L 时先纠正血糖
7. 疑似阿片类过量（针尖样瞳孔、低血压、低体温、心动过速）时给 Naloxone
8. 密切监测是否恶化为心脏骤停：同时评估呼吸和脉搏不超过 10 秒（严重低体温者可用 30-45 秒），无脉搏则开始 CPR
9. 转运并在途中继续评估/治疗
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: PCP may insert an SGA once high-quality management is initiated, may add a PEEP valve to the BVM, and may establish vascular access to give naloxone intravenously in cases of continued unconsciousness and apnea. EMR is limited to basic airway management, BVM ventilation, oxygen and naloxone.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: PCP 在高质量管理建立后可置入 SGA，可在 BVM 上加 PEEP 阀，并可在持续昏迷伴呼吸暂停时建立血管通路静脉给 naloxone。EMR 限于基础气道管理、BVM 通气、氧疗和 naloxone。
commonDeductionsEn: Not completing baseline vital signs (including blood glucose) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Not sufficiently assessing the patient to determine appropriate treatment, e.g. only assessing LOC to determine the need for Narcan - assess respiratory rate AND tidal volume
Moderate delay in treatment or subsequent doses of Narcan - 25%
Failing to support ventilations before/while administering naloxone - detrimental to patient care
commonDeductionsZh: 启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（含血糖）——扣 100%
评估不充分就决定治疗，例如只看 LOC 就决定给 Narcan——必须同时评估呼吸频率和潮气量
Narcan 首剂或后续剂量中度延迟——扣 25%
给 naloxone 之前/期间没有先支持通气——对患者有害

indicationsEn: Decreased LOC patients without a known cause
Known diabetic patients with decreased LOC whose history suggests hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia
Any patient in whom stroke, hypoglycemia, or narcotic overdose cannot yet be excluded
indicationsZh: 原因不明的意识水平下降患者
已知糖尿病患者意识下降，病史提示高血糖或低血糖
尚不能排除卒中、低血糖或麻醉药品过量的任何患者
contraindicationsEn: Oral glucose gel must not be used in patients without sufficient mentation to maintain their airway
contraindicationsZh: 意识不足以保护气道的患者禁用口服 glucose gel
stepsEn: 1. Complete a primary survey; manage the airway with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
2. Administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%; support ventilations if the respiratory drive is depressed
3. Position the patient in the lateral or 3/4 prone position if needed to protect the airway
4. Delegate crew members to prep egress
5. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs (must include blood glucose level)
6. Evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms (FAST-VAN)
7. If BGL < 4.0 mmol/L: correct hypoglycemia - glucose gel to the oral mucosa if mentation is sufficient; otherwise glucagon (EMR) or IV D10W 10-25 g (PCP)
8. If an opioid toxidrome is present (decreased LOC plus depressed respirations, miosis), administer Naloxone
9. Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route
stepsZh: 1. 完成 primary survey；通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器按需管理气道
2. 给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%；呼吸驱动受抑制时辅助通气
3. 必要时取侧卧位或 3/4 俯卧位保护气道
4. 指派队员准备撤离通道（prep egress）
5. 采集病史和基线生命体征（必须包含血糖）
6. 评估卒中症状和体征（FAST-VAN）
7. 血糖 < 4.0 mmol/L 时纠正低血糖——意识足够者口腔黏膜涂 glucose gel；否则 EMR 给 glucagon，PCP 静脉给 D10W 10-25 g
8. 存在阿片类中毒表现（意识下降+呼吸抑制+针尖样瞳孔）时给 Naloxone
9. 转运并在途中继续评估/治疗
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: EMR corrects hypoglycemia with glucose gel (sufficient mentation) or glucagon (insufficient mentation / unprotected airway). PCP obtains vascular access and corrects confirmed hypoglycemia with D10W 10-25 g (100-250 ml of 10%), using glucagon only if IV access cannot be obtained, and may give IV naloxone.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: EMR 用 glucose gel（意识足够时）或 glucagon（意识不足/气道不保护时）纠正低血糖。PCP 建立血管通路，用 D10W 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 ml）纠正确诊低血糖，打不上 IV 才用 glucagon，并可静脉给 naloxone。
commonDeductionsEn: Initiating the protocol without proper indications (e.g. the patient is not DLOC) - 100%
Not completing baseline vital signs (including blood glucose) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Major delay in treatment or subsequent doses of medication (IV dextrose) detrimental to patient care - 100%
Only assessing LOC to determine the need for Narcan - insufficient patient assessment
Minor delay in administration of Glucogel not detrimental to patient care - 15%
commonDeductionsZh: 无充分指征就启动协议（例如患者并非 DLOC）——扣 100%
启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（含血糖）——扣 100%
IV dextrose 首剂或后续剂量重大延迟且对患者有害——扣 100%
只评估 LOC 就决定是否给 Narcan——属评估不充分
Glucogel 给药轻微延迟（对患者无害）——扣 15%

indicationsEn: Suspected anaphylaxis with ALL of the following:
Signs of anaphylaxis: respiratory (SOB/wheezes/cough/stridor), abdominal (N/V/D/pain), hypotension (or decreased LOC), urticaria and/or angioneurotic edema and/or hypotension/shock
Exposure to an allergen
Unstable: syncope, decreased LOC, or hypotension (BP < 90 mmHg), or respiratory distress
indicationsZh: 疑似 anaphylaxis，须同时具备以下全部：
Anaphylaxis 体征：呼吸系统（SOB/哮鸣音/咳嗽/stridor）、腹部（恶心/呕吐/腹泻/腹痛）、低血压（或意识下降）、荨麻疹和/或血管神经性水肿和/或低血压/休克
过敏原（allergen）暴露史
不稳定表现：晕厥、意识下降、低血压（BP < 90 mmHg）或呼吸窘迫
stepsEn: 1. Position the patient supine to improve blood pressure and do NOT walk the patient
2. Remove the allergen (e.g., scrape off any stinger(s) / stop drug administration)
3. Complete a primary survey; provide airway management and supplemental oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
4. Delegate crew members to prep egress
5. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs
6. Administer Epinephrine
7. Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route
8. (PCP) If the patient remains hypotensive or hypoperfused: obtain vascular access and give a fluid bolus of 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
9. (PCP) Treat bronchospasm with Salbutamol AFTER epinephrine has been administered
10. (PCP) Administer Diphenhydramine to mitigate medium-term effects and limit the histamine response
stepsZh: 1. 让患者仰卧以改善血压，绝对不要让患者行走
2. 去除过敏原（例如刮除毒刺 / 停止药物输注）
3. 完成 primary survey；按需进行气道管理和补氧，维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
4. 指派队员准备撤离通道
5. 采集病史和基线生命体征
6. 给予 Epinephrine
7. 转运，途中继续评估和治疗
8.（PCP）仍低血压或低灌注时：建立血管通路，补液 bolus 20 ml/kg、最多 2 升、每 500 ml 重新评估
9.（PCP）Epinephrine 给完之后再用 Salbutamol 处理支气管痉挛
10.（PCP）给 Diphenhydramine 以缓解中期效应、限制组胺反应
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: Both levels administer epinephrine. PCP additionally obtains vascular access with a 20 ml/kg fluid bolus (max 2 L) for persistent hypotension, gives salbutamol for bronchospasm after epinephrine, and administers diphenhydramine.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: 两个级别都给 epinephrine。PCP 额外可以：对持续低血压建立血管通路并补液 20 ml/kg（上限 2 L）；epinephrine 之后用 salbutamol 处理支气管痉挛；给 diphenhydramine。
commonDeductionsEn: Major delay in treatment or subsequent doses of epinephrine detrimental to patient care - 100%
Failing to administer epinephrine when indicated by the protocol, detrimental to patient care - 100%
Not completing baseline vital signs prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Delay in treatment or subsequent doses of epinephrine potentially detrimental to patient care - lesser deduction
Walking the patient / standing them up - an act that may jeopardize the patient
commonDeductionsZh: Epinephrine 首剂或后续剂量重大延迟且对患者有害——扣 100%
协议有指征却未给 epinephrine 且对患者有害——扣 100%
启动协议前未完成基线生命体征——扣 100%
Epinephrine 延迟、可能对患者有害——较小档扣分
让患者行走/站立——属于可能危及患者的行为

indicationsEn: Patient in cardiac arrest: no pulse or breathing, or gasping breathing (assess breathing and pulse simultaneously, no more than 10 seconds)
Paediatric: no pulse, or pulse < 60/min with inadequate perfusion
indicationsZh: 心脏骤停患者：无脉搏、无呼吸或叹息样呼吸（gasping）（同时评估呼吸和脉搏，不超过 10 秒）
儿科：无脉搏，或脉搏 < 60 次/分伴灌注不足
contraindicationsEn: Verifiable Do Not Resuscitate (DNR) or No CPR orders
contraindicationsZh: 可核实的 Do Not Resuscitate（DNR）或 No CPR 指令
stepsEn: 1. Determine cardiac arrest: assess breathing and check pulse simultaneously, no more than 10 seconds
2. Begin CPR - adult 30:2 (one or two rescuers), rate 100-120/min, depth 5.0-6.0 cm; child/infant 30:2 one rescuer / 15:2 two rescuers, depth 1/3 to 1/2 chest diameter; neonate 3:1 with no AED
3. Position the AED and analyze as soon as possible
4. Shock advised: defibrillate, 2 minutes CPR, analyze, repeat. No shock advised: 2 minutes CPR, analyze, repeat. Resume CPR immediately after any shock and during charging
5. Keep interruptions under 5 seconds; change compressors every 2 minutes; ensure complete recoil; avoid hyperventilation

6. Consider treatable causes (H's and T's: hypovolemia, hypoxia, hydrogen ion, hypo/hyperkalemia, hypothermia, tension pneumothorax, tamponade, toxins including anaphylaxis, pulmonary/coronary thrombosis); transport may be considered if a reversible cause is apparent (also for paediatric, hypothermic, traumatic arrests)

7. Continue until: care is transferred to more advanced providers; there are signs of life; 30 minutes have elapsed with no ROSC and no defibrillations; or 40 minutes if there was ROSC at any time or any defibrillations
8. Consult medical oversight to discontinue the arrest at the scene
stepsZh: 1. 确定心脏骤停：同时评估呼吸和脉搏，不超过 10 秒
2. 开始 CPR——成人 30:2（单双人相同），频率 100-120 次/分、深度 5.0-6.0 cm；儿童/婴儿单人 30:2、双人 15:2，深度为胸廓前后径 1/3-1/2；新生儿 3:1 且不用 AED
3. 尽快贴 AED 并分析
4. 建议电击：除颤 → 2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复；不建议电击：2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复。电击后和充电期间都立即恢复按压
5. 中断少于 5 秒；每 2 分钟换人按压；胸廓完全回弹；避免过度通气
6. 排查可逆病因（H's and T's：低血容量、缺氧、酸中毒、低/高钾、低体温、张力性气胸、心包填塞、毒素含 anaphylaxis、肺栓塞/冠脉血栓）；存在明显可逆病因时可考虑转运（儿科、低体温、创伤性骤停同理）
7. 持续到：交接给更高级救护人员；出现生命迹象；30 分钟无 ROSC 且从未除颤；或曾有 ROSC/除颤时延长到 40 分钟
8. 现场终止复苏必须联系 medical oversight
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: Once high-quality cardiac arrest management is initiated, an SGA can be inserted by PCPs. Otherwise the CPR/AED algorithm is identical for both levels.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: 高质量骤停管理建立后，PCP 可置入 SGA（声门上气道）。除此之外两个级别的 CPR/AED 流程完全相同。
commonDeductionsEn: Performing chest compressions on a patient with a pulse - an act that may jeopardize the life of the patient - 100%
Performing the protocol with gross incompetence and/or two or more errors - 100%
Not ruling out the contraindication (a verifiable DNR / No CPR order), detrimental to patient care - 100%
Excessive interruptions to compressions (must stay under 5 seconds) / not reassessing after each analyze cycle
commonDeductionsZh: 对有脉搏的患者做胸外按压——属于可能危及患者生命的行为——扣 100%
执行协议时严重失误和/或出现两处及以上错误——扣 100%
未排除禁忌（可核实的 DNR / No CPR 指令）且对患者有害——扣 100%
按压中断过多（必须少于 5 秒）/每个分析周期后不重新评估

indicationsEn: Patients whose presentation is suggestive of cardiac chest pain
indicationsZh: 临床表现提示心源性胸痛的患者
contraindicationsEn: Rule out the contraindications of each medication (ASA, Nitroglycerin, Entonox) before administration
Nitroglycerin component: if SBP falls below 110 mmHg, switch to the Entonox pathway instead of further Nitroglycerin
contraindicationsZh: 给每种药之前都要排除该药的禁忌症（ASA、Nitroglycerin、Entonox）
Nitroglycerin 部分：收缩压跌破 110 mmHg 时改走 Entonox 路径，不再给 Nitroglycerin
stepsEn: 1. Place the patient in a position of comfort; in general, limit patient movement
2. Complete a primary survey and apply oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
3. Administer Acetylsalicylic acid, chewed and swallowed, if not already done prior to EHS arrival
4. Initiate transport (transport immediately if able; delegate crew members to prep egress if not)
5. Obtain a history (including pain assessment) and a baseline set of vital signs
6. Administer Nitroglycerin if appropriate (transport after the first dose if not already done)
7. If pain is completely relieved for more than 5 minutes but returns: re-initiate the Nitroglycerin component (but NOT the Aspirin component); continue assessment, treatment and vitals q 5 minutes

8. If pain persists beyond 3 doses of Nitroglycerin, or SBP falls below 110 mmHg: administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of Nitroglycerin; continue assessment, treatment and vitals q 5 minutes
9. After 30 minutes from the first dose of Nitroglycerin, the protocol may be repeated after stopping Nitrous Oxide for 5 minutes
10. (PCP) Obtain vascular access with running intravenous fluid; consider Dimenhydrinate for nausea
stepsZh: 1. 让患者取舒适体位；总体上限制患者活动
2. 完成 primary survey，按需给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
3. 给 Acetylsalicylic acid（ASA），嚼碎后吞服（如 EHS 到达前尚未服用）
4. 启动转运（能走立即转运；否则指派队员准备撤离通道）
5. 采集病史（含疼痛评估）和基线生命体征
6. 适当时给 Nitroglycerin（如尚未转运，第一剂后出发）
7. 疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后复发：重启 Nitroglycerin 部分（但绝不重复 Aspirin 部分）；每 5 分钟评估、治疗、测生命体征
8. 3 剂 Nitroglycerin 后疼痛仍持续，或收缩压跌破 110 mmHg：在最后一剂 Nitroglycerin 5 分钟后给 Entonox；每 5 分钟评估、治疗、测生命体征
9. 距第一剂 Nitroglycerin 30 分钟后，停用 Nitrous Oxide 5 分钟即可重复本协议
10.（PCP）建立血管通路并保持液体持续输注；恶心时考虑 Dimenhydrinate
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: PCP additionally obtains vascular access with running IV fluid and may give dimenhydrinate for nausea. The ASA / Nitroglycerin / Entonox sequence is the same for both levels.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: PCP 额外建立血管通路（保持液体输注），并可对恶心给 dimenhydrinate。ASA / Nitroglycerin / Entonox 的用药顺序两个级别相同。
commonDeductionsEn: Not completing baseline vital signs (including a pain assessment) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Failing to administer a medication indicated by the protocol (ASA/Nitro), detrimental to patient care - 100%
Moderate delay in treatment or subsequent doses of Nitro - 25%
Failing to administer Entonox when indicated, not detrimental to patient care - 25%
Not ruling out all the contraindications of a medication - 100% if detrimental, 25% if potentially detrimental
Repeating the Aspirin component when pain returns - only Nitroglycerin may be re-initiated
commonDeductionsZh: 启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（含疼痛评估）——扣 100%
协议有指征却未给药（ASA/Nitro）且对患者有害——扣 100%
Nitro 首剂或后续剂量中度延迟——扣 25%
有指征却未给 Entonox（对患者无害）——扣 25%
未排除药物全部禁忌——有害扣 100%，可能有害扣 25%
疼痛复发时重复 Aspirin 部分——只有 Nitroglycerin 可以重启

indicationsEn: Known diabetic patients with decreased LOC whose history suggests hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia
Decreased LOC patients without a known cause
indicationsZh: 已知糖尿病患者意识下降，病史提示高血糖或低血糖
原因不明的意识下降患者
contraindicationsEn: Oral glucose gel must not be used in patients with insufficient mentation to maintain their airway
contraindicationsZh: 意识不足以保护气道的患者禁用口服 glucose gel
stepsEn: 1. Complete a primary survey; manage the airway with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
2. Administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
3. Position the patient in the lateral or 3/4 prone position if needed
4. Delegate crew members to prep egress
5. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs (including blood glucose level)
6. Evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms
7. Correct suspected hypoglycemia (BGL < 4.0 mmol/L): for patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway, apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa
8. (EMR) For patients with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway, administer glucagon; transport and continue treatment en route
9. (PCP) Obtain vascular access; correct confirmed hypoglycemia with D10W 10-25 g (100-250 ml of 10% solution); glucagon if unable to obtain IV access
10. (PCP) Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route after the first bolus of D10 or the glucagon has been administered
stepsZh: 1. 完成 primary survey；通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器按需管理气道
2. 给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
3. 必要时取侧卧位或 3/4 俯卧位
4. 指派队员准备撤离通道
5. 采集病史和基线生命体征（必须包含血糖）
6. 评估卒中的症状和体征
7. 纠正疑似低血糖（BGL < 4.0 mmol/L）：意识足以保护气道者，把 glucose gel 涂在口腔黏膜上
8.（EMR）意识不足或气道不保护者给 glucagon；转运并在途中继续治疗
9.（PCP）建立血管通路；用 D10W 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 ml）纠正确诊低血糖；打不上 IV 才用 glucagon
10.（PCP）第一剂 D10 bolus 或 glucagon 给完后再出发，途中继续评估/治疗
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: EMR: glucose gel for patients with sufficient mentation; glucagon for insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway. PCP: vascular access and IV D10W 10-25 g is the first-line correction, with glucagon reserved for failed IV access.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: EMR：意识足够用 glucose gel，意识不足或气道不保护用 glucagon。PCP：建立血管通路，首选 IV D10W 10-25 g，打不上 IV 才用 glucagon。
commonDeductionsEn: Major delay in treatment or subsequent doses of IV dextrose, detrimental to patient care - 100%
Not completing baseline vital signs (including blood glucose) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Minor delay in administration of Glucogel not detrimental to patient care - 15%
Giving oral glucose gel to a patient without a protected airway - detrimental act
Initiating the protocol without proper indications (e.g. the patient is not DLOC) - 100%
commonDeductionsZh: IV dextrose 首剂或后续剂量重大延迟且对患者有害——扣 100%
启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（含血糖）——扣 100%
Glucogel 轻微延迟（对患者无害）——扣 15%
对气道不受保护的患者口服 glucose gel——属有害行为
无充分指征就启动协议（例如患者并非 DLOC）——扣 100%

indicationsEn: Patients with ALL of: hypovolemia, systolic BP < 90 mmHg, and other clinical signs or symptoms of shock
Patients with burns > 20% BSA (partial and full thickness)
May be used with BP > 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism of injury, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition
Hypotension from volume loss (e.g., vomiting/dehydration)
indicationsZh: 同时满足：hypovolemia（低血容量）、收缩压 < 90 mmHg、其他休克的临床症状或体征
烧伤面积 > 20% BSA（部分和全层厚度）的患者
如果根据受伤机制、损伤性质与范围或患者状况预计将出现休克，血压 > 90 mmHg 时也可使用
容量丢失导致的低血压（如呕吐/脱水）
contraindicationsEn: Tranexamic acid (TXA) is contraindicated for isolated traumatic brain injuries
contraindicationsZh: Tranexamic acid（TXA）在单纯创伤性脑损伤（isolated TBI）中禁用
stepsEn: 1. First: control external hemorrhage, splint pelvis/fractures if indicated, position the patient supine, keep warm, and give oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
2. Maintain aseptic technique throughout; gather and prepare equipment (select and inspect the catheter device, IV solution and administration set; prime the IV tubing)
3. Choose and prepare an appropriate site; initiate the IV; connect tubing and infuse solution
4. Calculate and maintain an appropriate flow rate (maintenance is approximately 75 mL/hr; gtts/min = volume to be infused x set rate / time in minutes)
5. Secure the IV
6. Fluid bolus to correct hypoperfusion or hypotension if clinically indicated: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml (target SBP 90 mmHg for volume loss)
7. Consider tranexamic acid in shock secondary to blood loss and hypovolemia secondary to occult bleeding
8. Reassess the patient and the IV regularly (q 5-15 min): ABCs and injury sites, vital signs, IV site/tubing/bag, complications, flow rate; change the solution bag if required
stepsZh: 1. 先做基础处置：控制外出血，有指征时夹板固定骨盆/骨折，仰卧位，保暖，给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
2. 全程无菌技术；准备器材（选择并检查留置针、液体和输液器；输液管排气）
3. 选择并准备穿刺部位；建立 IV；连接输液管并开始输液
4. 计算并维持滴速（维持速度约 75 mL/hr；gtts/min = 输液量 × 滴系数 ÷ 分钟数）
5. 固定 IV
6. 有临床指征时补液 bolus 纠正低灌注或低血压：20 ml/kg、最多 2 升、每 500 ml 重新评估（容量丢失时目标收缩压 90 mmHg）
7. 失血性休克和隐匿性出血导致的低血容量考虑 tranexamic acid
8. 定期（每 5-15 分钟）重新评估患者和 IV：ABC 和损伤部位、生命体征、穿刺点/管路/液袋、并发症、滴速；必要时更换液袋
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: IV therapy and fluid administration are PCP-only interventions. EMR supports the same patients with hemorrhage control, splinting, supine positioning, warmth and oxygen.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: IV 输液和补液是 PCP 专属操作。EMR 对同类患者做止血、夹板固定、仰卧位、保暖和氧疗等支持处置。
commonDeductionsEn: Not completing baseline vital signs prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Performing the protocol with gross incompetence and/or two or more errors - 100%
Performing the protocol with an isolated error with potential to be detrimental - 25%
Not reassessing every 500 ml during a fluid bolus / exceeding the 2 litre maximum
Not ruling out all the contraindications (e.g. TXA in isolated TBI), detrimental to patient care - 100%
commonDeductionsZh: 启动协议前未完成基线生命体征——扣 100%
执行协议严重失误和/或两处及以上错误——扣 100%
孤立错误但可能对患者有害——扣 25%
补液期间没有每 500 ml 重新评估/超过 2 升上限
未排除全部禁忌（如单纯 TBI 用 TXA）且对患者有害——扣 100%

indicationsEn: Open wounds with major hemorrhage
indicationsZh: 伴大出血的开放性伤口
contraindicationsEn: Do NOT pack wounds on the neck, chest, or abdomen
Tourniquets only in areas amenable to tourniquet application
Part elevation only if it does not aggravate other injuries or conditions
contraindicationsZh: 颈部、胸部、腹部的伤口禁止填塞（wound packing）
Tourniquet 只用于适合上止血带的部位
抬高患肢仅在不加重其他损伤时进行
stepsEn: 1. Expose and examine the wound
2. Apply direct pressure
3. Apply a pressure dressing
4. Position the part (elevate the injured part, only if it will not aggravate other injuries or conditions)
5. Position the patient (at rest and supine if other injuries and conditions permit)
6. If direct pressure fails and the area is amenable: apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound - note the time and do NOT release once applied
7. If the wound is not amenable to a tourniquet (junctional hemorrhage): extremity wound packing - never the neck, chest or abdomen
8. Bandage the bleed once hemorrhage has been controlled; assess distal circulation; recheck the bleed after every major move
stepsZh: 1. 暴露并检查伤口
2. 直接压迫（direct pressure）
3. 加压敷料（pressure dressing）
4. 摆放伤肢体位（抬高患肢，仅限不加重其他损伤时）
5. 摆放患者体位（休息、仰卧，前提是其他损伤允许）
6. 直接压迫无效且部位合适时：在伤口近端上 tourniquet——记录时间，一旦上紧绝不放松
7. 不适合 tourniquet 的部位（junctional hemorrhage 交界部位出血）：伤口填塞——颈/胸/腹绝对禁止
8. 出血控制后包扎；评估远端循环；每次大的移动后复查出血
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: The physical hemorrhage control ladder is identical for both levels. PCP may additionally obtain vascular access en route, correct hypoperfusion, and administer TXA if indicated (per the abdominal / chest trauma guidelines).
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: 物理止血阶梯两个级别完全相同。PCP 额外可以在途中建立血管通路、纠正低灌注，并按腹部/胸部创伤指南在有指征时给 TXA。
commonDeductionsEn: Not rechecking a deadly bleed after a major move - delay in reassessment of primary interventions
Packing a wound on the neck, chest or abdomen - detrimental act
Releasing a tourniquet after application / failing to note the time
Performing the skill with gross incompetence and/or two or more errors - 100%
commonDeductionsZh: 大的移动后不复查致命性出血——属于对 primary 干预复评延迟的扣分
对颈/胸/腹伤口做填塞——有害行为
上了 tourniquet 又放松/未记录时间
操作严重失误和/或两处及以上错误——扣 100%

indicationsEn: Patients experiencing the sensation of nausea or vomiting
indicationsZh: 出现恶心感或呕吐的患者
stepsEn: 1. Keep the patient at rest in a position of comfort
2. Maintain a position of comfort consistent with the need to protect the patient's airway; have suction ready at all times
3. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs
4. (PCP) Consider vascular access
5. (PCP) Consider dimenhydrinate
6. (PCP) Consider ondansetron
7. (PCP) Treat hypotension from volume loss - fluid bolus: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml; reassess after every bolus, target systolic blood pressure of 90 mmHg
8. Stable patients may be treated with anti-emetics on scene; unstable patients are treated en route to hospital
stepsZh: 1. 让患者在舒适体位下休息
2. 在保护气道的前提下维持舒适体位；suction 随时备用
3. 采集病史和基线生命体征
4.（PCP）考虑建立血管通路
5.（PCP）考虑 dimenhydrinate
6.（PCP）考虑 ondansetron
7.（PCP）治疗容量丢失引起的低血压——补液 bolus：20 ml/kg、最多 2 升、每 500 ml 重新评估；每次 bolus 后重评，目标收缩压 90 mmHg
8. 稳定患者可在现场用止吐药；不稳定患者在送医途中治疗
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: Anti-emetics (dimenhydrinate, ondansetron), vascular access and fluid boluses are PCP interventions. EMR management is limited to rest, positioning for airway protection and suction readiness.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: 止吐药（dimenhydrinate、ondansetron）、血管通路和补液都是 PCP 处置。EMR 限于休息、保护气道的体位摆放和备好 suction。
commonDeductionsEn: Not completing baseline vital signs prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Failing to administer a medication indicated by the protocol, not detrimental to patient care - 25%
Treating an unstable patient with anti-emetics on scene instead of en route - call management deficiency
Not ruling out all the cautions of a medication - 15%
commonDeductionsZh: 启动协议前未完成基线生命体征——扣 100%
协议有指征却未给药（对患者无害）——扣 25%
不稳定患者在现场给止吐药而不是途中处理——属呼叫管理缺陷
未排除药物的全部注意事项（cautions）——扣 15%

indicationsEn: Pain where analgesia is appropriate based on patient presentation (protocol component of wound care, musculoskeletal injuries, burns, hip injuries, electrical contact)
Stable, appropriate patients - analgesia is given PRIOR to movement, realignment, traction or fracture management
indicationsZh: 根据患者表现适合镇痛的疼痛（wound care、肌肉骨骼损伤、烧伤、髋部损伤、电击伤等的 protocol 阶段）
稳定且合适的患者——镇痛必须在移动、复位、牵引或骨折处理之前给
contraindicationsEn: Give analgesia only if not contraindicated - rule out the contraindications and cautions of each drug (Entonox, Acetaminophen, Ibuprofen) before administration
contraindicationsZh: 仅在无禁忌时镇痛——给药前排除每种药（Entonox、Acetaminophen、Ibuprofen）的禁忌症和注意事项
stepsEn: 1. Obtain a pain scale when indicated (failing to obtain one is a 5% deduction; inaccurate language 3%; inappropriate scale 1%)
2. Complete baseline vital signs before initiating the protocol
3. Rule out the contraindications and cautions of each analgesic
4. When indicated, administer all three: Entonox PLUS Acetaminophen and Ibuprofen

5. Sequence rule: Entonox must be on board BEFORE any realignment or fracture management; onboarding the Acetaminophen and Ibuprofen before the Entonox is acceptable (no deduction unless there is considerable delay in Entonox administration)
6. Reassess pain and vital signs after administration
7. There are no deductions associated with not verbalizing the 6 rights for medications
stepsZh: 1. 有指征时评估疼痛评分 pain scale（漏做扣 5%；用语导致不准确扣 3%；用错量表扣 1%）
2. 启动协议前完成基线生命体征
3. 排除每种镇痛药的禁忌症和注意事项
4. 有指征时三药都给：Entonox 加 Acetaminophen 和 Ibuprofen
5. 顺序规则：任何复位或骨折处理之前，Entonox 必须已经起效在身（on board）；先给 Acetaminophen 和 Ibuprofen、后给 Entonox 是可以接受的（除非 Entonox 给药明显拖延，否则不扣分）
6. 给药后重新评估疼痛和生命体征
7. 不口述药物「6 rights」不扣分
commonDeductionsEn: Delaying the Entonox until AFTER realignment or fracture management when Acetaminophen and Ibuprofen have been administered - 100%
Not administering Entonox when indicated where it causes further detriment (realigning a limb / performing fracture management) - 100%
Not administering Entonox when indicated where it does not cause further detriment - 25%
Administering Acetaminophen and Ibuprofen for pain but not Entonox - 25%
Administering only one of Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen (not both) and no Entonox - 25%
Administering Entonox for pain but not Acetaminophen and Ibuprofen (when indicated) - 10%
Administering only one of Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen (not both) but giving Entonox - 10%
Administering all three but onboarding Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen before the Entonox - no deduction unless considerable delay in Entonox administration
Failing to obtain a pain scale when indicated - 5%
commonDeductionsZh: 已给 Acetaminophen 和 Ibuprofen，却把 Entonox 拖到复位/骨折处理之后才给——扣 100%（直接挂）
有指征却不给 Entonox，并因此造成进一步伤害（复位肢体/做骨折处理时）——扣 100%
有指征却不给 Entonox，但未造成进一步伤害——扣 25%
只给 Acetaminophen 和 Ibuprofen、不给 Entonox——扣 25%
Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen 只给了一种（没给全）且没给 Entonox——扣 25%
只给 Entonox、没给（有指征的）Acetaminophen 和 Ibuprofen——扣 10%
Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen 只给了一种（没给全）但给了 Entonox——扣 10%
三药都给、但 Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen 先于 Entonox 起效——不扣分（除非 Entonox 明显拖延）
有指征却未做疼痛评分——扣 5%

indicationsEn: Shortness of breath with a history of asthma / COPD
Respiratory distress with suspected bronchospasm
indicationsZh: 有哮喘/COPD 病史的呼吸困难
疑似支气管痉挛的呼吸窘迫
contraindicationsEn: Never use an adult face mask with a flow rate below 6 L/min (delivers less oxygen than room air)
If escalating to CPAP (PCP), the full CPAP contraindication list applies (age <= 12, decreased LOC, SBP < 90 mmHg, pneumothorax, vomiting, trauma, tracheostomy, respiratory failure)
contraindicationsZh: 成人面罩流量绝不能低于 6 L/min（低于此给氧比室内空气还少）
如升级到 CPAP（PCP），须套用 CPAP 全部禁忌（年龄 ≤ 12、意识下降、SBP < 90 mmHg、气胸、呕吐、创伤、气管切开、呼吸衰竭）
stepsEn: 1. Place the patient in a position of comfort - generally seated and leaning forward; limit patient movement
2. Complete a primary survey and provide supplemental oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94% (caution: may not be achievable); auscultate
3. Initiate transport (immediately if able; delegate crew members to prep egress if not)
4. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs

5. Salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI (transport after the first dose if not already done); MDI and spacer strongly recommended for influenza-like or infectious respiratory illness; if the patient is ventilated, administer MDI via the side port on the BVM
6. (PCP) Salbutamol with ipratropium - both may be combined in the same nebulizer; ipratropium is a single dose, salbutamol may be repeated
7. (PCP) For severe disease or imminent respiratory failure: IM Epinephrine - considered for SpO2 < 90% and/or moderate to severe bronchospasm unresolved with salbutamol
8. (PCP) Consider dexamethasone; consider CPAP

9. Titrate O2: up to 15 L/min for SpO2 94%, then non-rebreather at 15 L/min, then add nasal cannula at 15 L/min underneath, then CPAP (PCP), then assisted ventilations (PEEP for PCPs); record SpO2 changes through treatment
stepsZh: 1. 舒适体位——通常坐位、身体前倾；限制患者活动
2. 完成 primary survey，按需补氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%（注意：可能达不到）；听诊
3. 启动转运（能走立即转运；否则指派队员准备撤离通道）
4. 采集病史和基线生命体征
5. Salbutamol 雾化或 MDI（如尚未转运，第一剂后出发）；流感样/呼吸道感染表现强烈建议 MDI + spacer；已被通气的患者经 BVM 侧孔给 MDI
6.（PCP）Salbutamol 联合 ipratropium——可混同一雾化器；ipratropium 只给一次，salbutamol 可重复
7.（PCP）病情严重或即将呼吸衰竭：肌注 Epinephrine——SpO2 < 90% 和/或 salbutamol 无效的中重度支气管痉挛时考虑
8.（PCP）考虑 dexamethasone；考虑 CPAP
9. 氧疗升级：滴定至最大 15 L/min 达 SpO2 94% → NRB 面罩 15 L/min → 面罩下加鼻导管 15 L/min → CPAP（PCP）→ 辅助通气（PCP 加 PEEP）；记录治疗中 SpO2 变化
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: EMR: oxygen plus salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI. PCP adds ipratropium co-administration, IM epinephrine for severe disease, dexamethasone, and CPAP/PEEP.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: EMR：氧疗 + salbutamol（雾化或 MDI）。PCP 额外可联合 ipratropium、对重症肌注 epinephrine、给 dexamethasone、上 CPAP/PEEP。
commonDeductionsEn: Not completing baseline vital signs prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Failing to administer salbutamol when indicated, detrimental to patient care - 100%
Moderate delay in treatment or subsequent doses of medication - 25%
Not ruling out all the cautions of a medication - 15%
Repeating ipratropium (it is a single-dose administration) - protocol error
commonDeductionsZh: 启动协议前未完成基线生命体征——扣 100%
有指征却未给 salbutamol 且对患者有害——扣 100%
治疗或后续剂量中度延迟——扣 25%
未排除药物的全部注意事项——扣 15%
重复给 ipratropium（它只能给一次）——协议错误

indicationsEn: Decreased level of consciousness AND depressed respiratory drive, demonstrated by both decreased rate and limited tidal volume
Supporting signs: pinpoint pupils (miosis), hypotension, hypothermia, tachycardia
indicationsZh: 意识水平下降且呼吸驱动受抑制（呼吸频率下降和潮气量受限两者都要有）
支持性体征：针尖样瞳孔（miosis）、低血压、低体温、心动过速
stepsEn: 1. Complete a primary survey; manage the airway with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
2. Support ventilations as required; consider two-person BVM techniques
3. Administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
4. Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs (including blood glucose level)
5. If blood glucose <= 4 mmol/L, correct the glucose level
6. Administer Naloxone
7. Transport and continue assessment / treatment / protocol en route
8. (PCP) In cases of continued unconsciousness and apnea, consider establishing vascular access and giving naloxone intravenously
stepsZh: 1. 完成 primary survey；通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器按需管理气道
2. 按需支持通气；考虑双人 BVM 技术
3. 给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
4. 采集病史和基线生命体征（必须包含血糖）
5. 血糖 ≤ 4 mmol/L 时先纠正血糖
6. 给 Naloxone
7. 转运，途中继续评估/治疗/执行协议
8.（PCP）持续昏迷且呼吸暂停时，考虑建立血管通路并静脉给 naloxone
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: Both levels ventilate, correct low glucose and administer naloxone. PCP may additionally establish vascular access and give naloxone intravenously for continued unconsciousness and apnea.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: 两个级别都做通气、纠正低血糖并给 naloxone。PCP 额外可在持续昏迷伴呼吸暂停时建立血管通路、静脉给 naloxone。
commonDeductionsEn: Only assessing LOC to determine the need for Narcan - not sufficiently assessing the patient (assess rate AND tidal volume) - 25%
Moderate delay in treatment or subsequent doses of Narcan - 25%
Not completing baseline vital signs (including blood glucose) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Failing to support ventilations before naloxone - detrimental to patient care
commonDeductionsZh: 只看 LOC 就决定给 Narcan——评估不充分（必须评估呼吸频率和潮气量）——扣 25%
Narcan 首剂或后续剂量中度延迟——扣 25%
启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（含血糖）——扣 100%
给 naloxone 前不先支持通气——对患者有害

indicationsEn: Suspected hypothermia because of mechanism of injury, history, or presentation
Heat exhaustion / heatstroke
Drowning / near drowning
Electrical contact injuries
indicationsZh: 根据受伤机制、病史或表现怀疑低体温症
热衰竭/热射病
溺水/近溺水
电击伤
contraindicationsEn: Severe hypothermia (< 28 C): do NOT actively rewarm
Electrical burns: do not cool longer than 15-20 minutes, including decontamination time
Electrical scenes: do not approach electrical sources or downed power lines until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe
contraindicationsZh: 重度低体温（< 28 C）：禁止主动复温
电烧伤：冷却（含去污时间）不得超过 15-20 分钟
电击现场：有资质人员确认安全前，绝不接近电源或倒落的电线
stepsEn: 1. Ensure scene safety first (electrical: wait for qualified personnel to declare the scene safe)
2. Assess and maintain the ABCs; in the severely hypothermic patient take up to 30-45 seconds to determine pulselessness

3. Hypothermia: remove wet and cold clothing and cover with blankets or dry clothing; take temperature if appropriate. Mild (>32 to <35 C) and moderate (>28 to <32 C): actively rewarm - mild activity if appropriate, preheat the ambulance to 30 C, hot packs wrapped in towels, warm blankets. Severe (<28 C): insulate only, heat the ambulance to 30 C, avoid rough handling
4. Hypothermic cardiac arrest: apply AED and analyze, defibrillate up to three times if indicated, then continue CPR without pauses for analysis or shocks and transport rapidly

5. Heatstroke: move to a cool area, remove all clothing, begin convective cooling (AC on maximum cold) and evaporative cooling (cold wet towels to head, torso, thighs), immerse feet and legs in ice water; cool for a minimum of 10 minutes before conveyance; include blood glucose in initial vitals if decreased LOC; continue the most aggressive cooling available during transport

6. Drowning: apply spinal motion restriction as indicated by mechanism; keep at rest, position sitting up, remove wet clothing and dry the patient, avoid rough handling, maintain body temperature; initiate IPPV if required to support failing respirations; if in arrest, resuscitate per the appropriate guideline

7. Electrical contact: consider spinal motion restriction; if in cardiac arrest begin compressions per resuscitation guidelines; flush and decontaminate affected areas with sterile saline; dress injuries; identify current type and contact duration; estimate BSA with Burn Estimation Charts; consider analgesia to effect if no inhalation injury
8. Initiate conveyance; consider intercept with additional resources; use the ambulance heater if significant body surface area cooling was required
stepsZh: 1. 首先确保现场安全（电击：等有资质人员宣布现场安全）
2. 评估并维持 ABC；严重低体温患者判断无脉搏可用最长 30-45 秒
3. 低体温：脱掉湿冷衣物，用毯子或干衣物覆盖；适当时测体温。轻度（>32 至 <35 C）和中度（>28 至 <32 C）：主动复温——适当轻度活动、救护车预热到 30 C、毛巾包裹的热敷袋、加温毯子。重度（<28 C）：只做隔热保温、车厢加热到 30 C、避免粗暴搬动
4. 低体温心脏骤停：贴 AED 分析，有指征时最多除颤三次，之后不再为分析或电击暂停 CPR，快速转运
5. 热射病：移到凉爽区域、脱去全部衣物、对流降温（空调最大冷）+ 蒸发降温（头/躯干/大腿冷湿毛巾）、双脚小腿浸冰水；出发前至少降温 10 分钟；意识下降时首套生命体征含血糖；途中持续用最激进的降温方式
6. 溺水：按受伤机制决定脊柱活动限制；静息、坐位、脱湿衣擦干、轻柔搬动、维持体温；呼吸衰竭时启动 IPPV；骤停按相应指南复苏
7. 电击伤：考虑脊柱活动限制；骤停时按复苏指南开始按压；用无菌生理盐水冲洗去污；包扎伤口；确认电流类型和接触时长；用 Burn Estimation Charts 估算烧伤面积；无吸入性损伤时可镇痛滴定至有效
8. 启动转运；考虑与其他资源途中会合；若曾大面积体表降温，途中开启车内暖气
protocols.emrPcpDiffEn: PCP may additionally: consider fluid replacement for dehydration in heat illness; use PEEP or CPAP if indicated in drowning; obtain vascular access after electrical contact and give a fluid bolus of 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres (reassessing every 500 ml) for hypotension while considering other causes of shock.
protocols.emrPcpDiffZh: PCP 额外可以：热病脱水时考虑补液；溺水有指征时用 PEEP 或 CPAP；电击伤后建立血管通路，对低血压补液 20 ml/kg、上限 2 升、每 500 ml 重评，同时考虑其他休克原因。
commonDeductionsEn: Actively rewarming a severely hypothermic patient / rough handling - an act that could aggravate the patient's condition
Not completing baseline vital signs (including blood glucose with decreased LOC) prior to initiating the protocol - 100%
Transporting a heatstroke patient without a minimum of 10 minutes of cooling - detrimental omission
Performing the protocol with gross incompetence and/or two or more errors - 100%
commonDeductionsZh: 对重度低体温患者主动复温/粗暴搬动——属于可能加重病情的行为
启动协议前未完成基线生命体征（意识下降时须含血糖）——扣 100%
热射病患者未先降温至少 10 分钟就转运——属有害遗漏
执行协议严重失误和/或两处及以上错误——扣 100%
